parts.label: (d)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Method 1: $4a-3>2$ (allow $\ge$ at this stage, with $x$ or $a$) — M1. Do not allow an equals sign or a “not equal to” relation unless a correct inequality is reached later. $a>\frac54$ or $a\ge\frac54$ — A1 OE. Accept $(\frac54,\infty)$, $[\frac54,\infty)$ and equivalent interval forms. Method 2: $3(4a-3)-6>0$ (allow $\ge$ at this stage, with $x$ or $a$) — M1. Do not allow an equals sign or a “not equal to” relation unless a correct inequality is reached later. $a>\frac54$ or $a\ge\frac54$ — A1 OE; accept the same open or left-closed interval forms. Total 2.
